summary: Erwin draws the Female Titan into the forest of giant trees. Levi's squad waits in the branches with the order not to move until the trap closes.

segments.ja: エルヴィンは陣形を、巨木の森へ曲げます。右翼を削られながら、なお直進しない判断です。新兵の多くは理由を知りません。ジャンは、被害を捨てて道を変える団長を信用しきれずに馬を進めます。森の木は壁の材木ではなく、立体機動装置が喜ぶ高さまで枝を広げています。アルミンはその高さを見たとき、初めて今日の被害が無駄ではないかもしれないと思いました。罠の入口に見えたのです。
segments.en: Erwin bent the formation toward the forest of giant trees. A decision not to go straight, even after the right wing had been cut down. Most recruits did not know the reason. Jean rode on, unable to fully trust a Commander who changed the road and left the losses behind. The trees were not lumber for the walls. Their branches spread high enough that ODM gear would be glad of them. When Armin saw that height, he thought for the first time that today's losses might not be waste. It looked like the mouth of a trap.

segments.ja: 特別作戦班は森の奥、高い枝の上で馬を降りません。命令は待機です。女型の巨人が来ても、合図の前に手を出すな。エレンは拳を固め、リヴァイに視線で問います。今なら変身できるかもしれない。リヴァイは首を横に振ります。ここで巨人になれば、エルヴィンの罠が自分の位置を敵に教えます。ペトラはエレンの肩に短く触れ、待てることを信頼の形にして見せました。待てないことが、今日の敗北条件です。
segments.en: Deep in the forest, the Special Operations Squad did not dismount so much as stop in the high branches. The order was to wait. Even if the Female Titan came, do not move a hand before the signal. Eren closed his fist and asked Levi with a look. He might be able to transform now. Levi shook his head. Becoming a Titan here would teach the enemy where he was and break Erwin's trap. Petra touched Eren's shoulder briefly and made waiting look like a form of trust. Not being able to wait was today's condition for defeat.

segments.ja: アルミンは森の入口付近で、自分の図が正しかったことを苦しい形で確認します。女型の巨人は右翼を抜け、中央の方向を間違えていません。索敵陣形は敵に読まれ、読まれたうえでこの森まで誘導されています。誘導されていると知っているのは、エルヴィンと、図を描いたアルミンくらいです。新兵はまだ、逃げる森だと思っています。アルミンはジャンに、全部は説明できません。説明すれば、待つ理由が怒りに変わるからです。
segments.en: Near the mouth of the forest, Armin confirmed in a painful way that his diagram had been right. The Female Titan had come through the right wing and had not mistaken the direction of the center. The scouting formation had been read, and after being read it had been led as far as this forest. The people who knew they were being led were roughly Erwin, and Armin who had drawn the diagram. The recruits still thought the forest was a place to flee into. Armin could not explain all of it to Jean. If he explained, the reason for waiting would turn into anger.

segments.ja: 木の上の時間は、戦闘より長く感じられます。オルオは沈黙に耐えきれず小さな文句を言い、エルドが目で止めます。グンターはワイヤーの角度を測り、ペトラはエレンの呼吸を見ます。リヴァイはほとんど動きません。特別作戦班の仕事は、今日は強さを見せることではなく、見せないことでした。エレンはその静止を、自分への不信だと受け取りかけ、すぐに訂正します。不信も含んだ、もっと大きい命令です。団長の罠が閉まるまで、中央は存在しないふりをします。
segments.en: Time in the trees felt longer than a fight. Oluo could not bear the silence and made a small complaint. Eld stopped him with a look. Gunther measured the angle of a cable. Petra watched Eren's breathing. Levi barely moved. The Special Operations Squad's work today was not to show strength. It was not to show it. Eren almost took that stillness as distrust of him, and then corrected himself. It was a larger order, and distrust was included in it. Until the Commander's trap closed, the center would pretend not to exist.

segments.en: In the forest the smoke was hard to see, and messages went back to voices and horses. When what was left of the right wing wanted to report the Female Titan's speed, the messenger was already half a step late. Jean tried to fill that lateness with his own legs and nearly took the wrong path. Reiner turned the horse back. Information is not enough when it is correct. Someone has to be in the place where it can arrive. Armin had never felt that ordinary fact as cruelly as today. He held the correct diagram, and it had not yet reached the squad in the branches.

segments.en: Erwin's trap was made of the giant branches and a great quantity of cable. When the Female Titan entered one particular place in the forest, the cables would come down like a net and stop its movement. Not a killing. A capture. If they captured it, they could ask what was inside a face that knew things. The recruits could not see the whole of that. What they could see was that the Commander took the danger in front, and that they themselves were being used as the walls of a lure. Armin understood the structure, and because he understood it he could not hate the Commander easily.

segments.en: The Female Titan's footsteps finally arrived under the branches. Eren's fist hardened again. Unlike yesterday's failure, the conditions for transformation felt complete. There were people to protect. There was a purpose. There was anger. The order was still to wait. Levi saw the fist and did not give permission. Petra shook her head, small. segments.en: With the signal, cables dropped onto the Female Titan. Between the giant trees, a fast body stopped for a long moment for the first time. Survey Corps cannon fire cut the movement further. The capture looked like a success. A short relief leaked from the squad in the branches. Oluo used a triumphant voice. Eld warned him that it was not over. Levi did not descend either. From high up, Eren clearly saw the Female Titan's face for the first time. Eyes like a person's were still searching for something inside the net.

segments.en: The shape of success shook at once. Inside the net the Female Titan screamed, and as if answering, Titans nearby started toward the forest. Parts of the body, hard as if they had crystallized, threw the cables off. The capture was not complete. It was in the middle. Messages were late again. Raise the smoke for retreat, or continue a second restraint. In the soldiers' eyes, a hole had suddenly opened in Erwin's calculation. Armin understood that the enemy still had a plan after being caught. An enemy with a plan is not an Abnormal.

segments.en: The Special Operations Squad still did not leave the branches. Levi's order was to hold until Erwin's next instruction. Eren looked at the Female Titan's eyes and at the number of approaching Titans at the same time. If they kept waiting, the net would tear. If they descended, the secret of the center would end. Either choice would add to the classmates' deaths. Petra took Eren's sleeve lightly and repeated that it was not yet time. The forest of giant trees was a trap, and it had also become a place where waiting itself was the fight.

segments.en: At the entrance to the forest of giant trees, the horses all nearly stopped. Smell, or a shake in the ground: the animals knew the danger of the trap first. Recruits pulled the reins. Veterans of the Survey Corps stroked the horses' ears and made them go. Jean's horse stepped back once, and he confused that with his own weakness. Armin thought the horses might be right, and he still did not leave Erwin's line of march. Not leaving it was his resolve today. Inside the forest there was height for ODM gear, and at the same time a darkness that took smoke signals away.

segments.ja: 罠のワイヤーは、枝に事前に結ばれ、一箇所の合図でまとめて落ちるよう調整されています。ハンジではなく、エルヴィンの準備した捕獲の道具です。兵はその仕組みの全部を知りません。知るのは、自分の担当の結び目だけです。アルミンは一部を見せられ、全体を推測します。推測は正しい図に近づきます。近づくほど、右翼の死がこの結び目のための時間だったと分かり、彼は結び目を憎みきれません。憎めば、今からほどく理由になってしまうからです。
segments.en: The trap's cables were tied to the branches in advance and adjusted to fall together at one signal. They were capture tools Erwin had prepared, not Hange's. The soldiers did not know the whole mechanism. Each knew only the knot they were responsible for. Armin was shown a part and guessed the whole. The guess moved closer to the correct diagram. The closer it moved, the more he understood that the deaths on the right wing had been time purchased for these knots, and he could not fully hate the knots. If he hated them, that would become a reason to untie them now.

segments.en: At one particular place in the forest, Survey Corps cannon were hidden. They were there to cut down movement after the Female Titan entered the net. The gunners practiced, for a long time, not firing. Not firing was today's skill. Jean learned about the cannon later and thought about what it meant that they had been led in front of it. Had they been the walls of the lure. Armin neither confirmed nor denied it. If he confirmed it, Jean's anger would turn toward Erwin and the formation would split from the inside. So that it would not split, Armin kept part of the diagram only inside himself.

segments.en: When Jean grabbed Armin's sleeve and demanded a reason, Armin told him only half. This forest was not a refuge. It was a place to stop the Female Titan. He did not say who had decided that, or what the right wing had purchased. Jean was angry at the half and persuaded by the half. The persuaded side was the side that kept the horse moving today. In the branches, Eren did not know that conversation. Not knowing it, he left the meaning of waiting in Petra's one sentence. Nobody could yet measure how heavy that one sentence would become later.

segments.en: Today's words. The forest of giant trees is where the Survey Corps lured the Female Titan. The long-range scouting formation turned, there, into the entrance of a capture. A message is danger carried by smoke and horses. Retreat is a choice that has not been permitted yet. Commander Erwin used the losses as information, all the way to the forest. The Special Operations Squad's mission in the branches is not to transform. The capture nearly succeeded, and it is not finished. Even inside the net, the Female Titan's eyes were still searching.

vocab.exampleEn: Erwin bent the formation toward the forest of giant trees. A decision not to go straight, even after the right wing had been cut down. Most recruits did not know the reason. Jean rode on, unable to fully trust a Commander who changed the road and left the losses behind. The trees were not lumber for the walls. It looked like the mouth of a trap.

Raise the smoke for retreat, or continue a second restraint. In the soldiers' eyes, a hole had suddenly opened in Erwin's calculation. Armin understood that the enemy still had a plan after being caught. An enemy with a plan is not an Abnormal.

vocab.exampleJa: 説明すれば、待つ理由が怒りに変わるからです。
vocab.exampleEn: Near the mouth of the forest, Armin confirmed in a painful way that his diagram had been right. The Female Titan had come through the right wing and had not mistaken the direction of the center. The scouting formation had been read, and after being read it had been led as far as this forest. The people who knew they were being led were roughly Erwin, and Armin who had drawn the diagram. The recruits still thought the forest was a place to flee into. Armin could not explain all of it to Jean. If he explained, the reason for waiting would turn into anger.

vocab.exampleJa: 匂いか、地面の揺れか、動物のほうが先に罠の危険を知ります。
vocab.exampleEn: At the entrance to the forest of giant trees, the horses all nearly stopped. Smell, or a shake in the ground: the animals knew the danger of the trap first. Recruits pulled the reins. Veterans of the Survey Corps stroked the horses' ears and made them go. Jean's horse stepped back once, and he confused that with his own weakness. Armin thought the horses might be right, and he still did not leave Erwin's line of march. Not leaving it was his resolve today. Inside the forest there was height for ODM gear, and at the same time a darkness that took smoke signals away.

vocab.exampleJa: エルヴィンは陣形を、巨木の森へ曲げます。
vocab.exampleEn: Erwin bent the formation toward the forest of giant trees. A decision not to go straight, even after the right wing had been cut down. Most recruits did not know the reason. Jean rode on, unable to fully trust a Commander who changed the road and left the losses behind. The trees were not lumber for the walls. Their branches spread high enough that ODM gear would be glad of them. When Armin saw that height, he thought for the first time that today's losses might not be waste. It looked like the mouth of a trap.

vocab.exampleJa: 知らないまま、待つことの意味をペトラの一言に預けています。
vocab.exampleEn: When Jean grabbed Armin's sleeve and demanded a reason, Armin told him only half. This forest was not a refuge. It was a place to stop the Female Titan. He did not say who had decided that, or what the right wing had purchased. Jean was angry at the half and persuaded by the half. The persuaded side was the side that kept the horse moving today. In the branches, Eren did not know that conversation. Not knowing it, he left the meaning of waiting in Petra's one sentence. Nobody could yet measure how heavy that one sentence would become later.

vocab.exampleJa: 女型の巨人が来ても、合図の前に手を出すな。
vocab.exampleEn: Deep in the forest, the Special Operations Squad did not dismount so much as stop in the high branches. The order was to wait. Even if the Female Titan came, do not move a hand before the signal. Eren closed his fist and asked Levi with a look. He might be able to transform now. Levi shook his head. Becoming a Titan here would teach the enemy where he was and break Erwin's trap. Petra touched Eren's shoulder briefly and made waiting look like a form of trust. Not being able to wait was today's condition for defeat.

personalUse: Original study narration for Jeremy. Vocabulary and plot beats were taken from a private reading of the episode. The anime's dialogue is not included.
